name: Age-wise Quotation Report
query:
SELECT
    q.party_name AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",

    COUNT(q.name) AS "Total Quotations:Int:130",

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), q.transaction_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "0-30 Days:Int:120",

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), q.transaction_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 60
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "31-60 Days:Int:120",

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), q.transaction_date) BETWEEN 61 AND 90
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "61-90 Days:Int:120",

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), q.transaction_date) > 90
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "90+ Days:Int:120",

    SUM(q.grand_total) AS "Grand Total:Currency:150",

    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT q.status ORDER BY q.status SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Status:Data:150"

FROM
    `tabQuotation` q

WHERE
    q.docstatus < 2
    AND q.status = 'Open'

GROUP BY
    q.party_name

ORDER BY
    q.party_name;
